why: wiki/real-estate.md: XLRE 43.42 (-1.16% W/W), a third straight week under the 50D, with PLD and O both losing their 200Ds.
wiki/canary-watch.md: the 10Y closed 4.975%, a fresh 52W high and its fourth straight 52W-high close, 2.5bp from the 5.00% line.
wiki/real-estate.md: the 200D held its first test by 23 cents, so the structural line is intact but barely.
risks: A dovish FOMC surprise or a 10Y retreat from 4.975% would produce a violent rate-proxy rally from oversold.
The 200D held by 23 cents; if it holds again the downtrend read is premature.
